what: Were the wages printed in Lunenburg's 2009 annual town report earned in calendar 2009 or in fiscal 2009?
why: The payroll pages (PDF pages 84-89) print NAME, DEPT. and WAGES with no heading naming a year or a basis; the index (p5) calls them only `Payroll Report`. The 2010 edition prints `CALENDAR 2010 WAGES` and FY2011 onward print fiscal-year earnings, so this year cannot be placed beside either. Textract text searched for calendar, fiscal, W-2, gross and wages: `calendar` appears only in department narratives (p18, p22, p33, p45), never on or near the payroll pages (sources/data/report-tables/2009/). — closes: the Town's 2009 payroll report as run by the Treasurer or Accountant, with its date range.

what: How much of Lunenburg's debt at 30 June 2009 sat inside the debt limit, and how much outside it?
why: `outstanding-debt` reads this from the five-year outstanding-debt summary the FY2011-FY2025 reports print. The 2009 annual town report prints its bonded indebtedness issue by issue (PDF page 64) and a repayment schedule by fiscal year (pages 65-66), with no summary by purpose and no debt-limit split: its Textract text was searched for debt limit, outstanding, inside, outside and exempt, and returned nothing about debt but the column label `PRINCIPAL (82% EXEMPT)` on p65 (the other hits are narrative: outstanding athletes, outside the district). — closes: the Town's FY2009 Statement of Indebtedness as filed with the Division of Local Services.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did Lunenburg's Sealer of Weights & Measures test, seal, adjust or condemn in 2009?
why: The 2010 edition prints the Inspector of Weights & Measures' device counts and the Chapter 295 savings report (`report-weights-measures`). The 2009 edition prints no such report: its Textract text was searched for seal, weights, scales, condemn, savings impact and chapter 295, and returned only a receipts line `SEALING FEES` (p47), the appropriation and omnibus lines (p50, p73, p78), the `Weights/Measures Citation Fund` special revenue line (p59) and a payroll department label (p88). — closes: the Sealer's 2009 annual report to the Massachusetts Division of Standards.

what: What were Lunenburg's non-union grade-and-step pay rates and job classifications in 2009?
why: The 2010 edition prints Schedule A, the salary schedule and classification plan adopted under Article 5 (`salary-schedule`, `report-classification-plan`). The 2009 edition prints neither: its Textract text was searched for schedule a, step, point value, class title, classification and salary schedule, and returned only the appropriation schedule's own heading (pp49-53), Personnel Committee prose saying it was developing `a major revamp of the Salary Schedule` (p22), and town meeting articles amending the Salary Administration Plan's holiday and merit provisions (p74, p77) without printing the schedule; `step` hits only a school programme name (p39) and a merit article (p77). — closes: the Salary Administration Plan bylaw's Schedule A as in force for 2009, from the Town Clerk.
